plan.title: Single-stage RFQ with evaluation time cleared

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested product and quantity; the product's available variant is selected by the product flow.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Add the vendor named by the test case.
Commit a 15-minute event duration so the schedule can be edited and saved.
Clear the evaluation time as required by the case.
Verify the schedule drawer represents evaluation time as not applicable after clearing it.
Save the schedule with evaluation time cleared.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
